readables.title: Note on Rita's table
readables.text:
Rita -
The man from the Vesper asked about you again. Said he'd tip big if you came by after close. I said you don't go out after your shift.
Don't go. I mean it.
- Gus

readables.title: Ledger, back room
readables.text:
SABATO - owes 0. Paid in full, early. Strange.
KESSLER - $400 by the 15th. Third week late.
Abe says he has something coming in that will square it. Says it's old. Says it's worth more than the shop.
The back room is not for Vinnie's people. Tell him.

items.name: Locked tin box, very heavy, marked 'NOT FOR SALE'

readables.title: Abe's appointment book
readables.text:
THURS. 7th
- Feld, her husband's ring. Gave $30. Don't sell.
- C.M. from the Vesper, about the box. 'After midnight.' Who does business after midnight.
- Marv, $400. Tell him Friday.
FRI. 8th
- Bank. Then the man from the Vesper again.

items.name: Pawn ticket #0612 (Abe's Loans, a wedding ring)

readables.title: Your notebook
readables.text:
July 7.
Three weeks on Ellery Street. The landlord doesn't ask questions as long as it's cash.
Things I know: the diner never closes. The bar's back room has a lock that's newer than the door. The Vesper opens at ten and nobody goes in before eleven. Abe at the pawn shop keeps a book of who owes him.
Things I don't know: what I am now.

readables.title: Daily News, left on a table
readables.text:
DAILY NEWS - Thursday, July 7, 1977
HEAT WAVE TO CONTINUE; CON ED SAYS GRID 'SOUND'
Police still seek .44 gunman. Mayor urges calm.
In Brief: Third disappearance reported on Lower East Side this month; police say no connection.

items.name: Letter to Abe, no stamp, wax seal broken

readables.title: Letter on Abe's desk
readables.text:
Mr. Kessler,
The item you hold was never yours to sell, and it was never your father's to keep. We will pay what you owe and more besides. Bring it to the Vesper after midnight on Friday. Come alone, and come inside. It is important that you come inside.
- C.
